notes: kb/Work PB565 (vertical axis). All four sub-rules of the multiple LINE clause are enforced on COBOL2199: a) the NEXT PAGE phrase only with the first operand, b) all absolute operands before all relative ones, c) the occurrences of integer-1 ascending, d) no OCCURS clause in the same entry (the negative golden). The clause itself is LIVE - 13.18.35.4 GR9's equivalence is how the binder builds it - and the positive golden prints its three operands at page lines 2, 4 and 7 and, on a second entry, drives a VARYING counter over them. The form is a COBOL-2002 introduction (report-multi-line-2002, COBOL0900 below it), witnessed by pb565-report-multiple-line-at-85. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#MultipleLineOperands (kb/Work PB2357 split DataBinder.Reports.cs: the same code, unchanged, now lives in ReportSectionBinder.cs (the binder), ReportModel.cs (the model types) and ReportScope.cs (the visible-report lookups))
